Inbound: strands_base_agent/application/tls_config.py:62-93 fails the server closed via sys.exit(1) if tls_mode is unset, invalid, or if 'native' mode lacks readable keyfile/certfile. strands_base_agent/server.py:396-416 validates TLS posture before uvicorn.run and passes ssl_keyfile/ssl_certfile in native mode. Configured via tls_mode in config.yaml (default platform) or STRANDS_TLS_MODE env var; documented in docs/tls-posture.md (which explicitly cites V-222596 / APSC-DV-002440). Outbound: foundry_strands_agent/tls.py:6 cites V-222596 / CCI-002418; create_tls_context() enforces TLS 1.2 minimum and certificate verification on by default for all outbound MCP HTTPS calls. Test coverage in tests/unit/application/tls_config_test.py for unset / invalid / platform / native / missing-files paths.

Bandit B602/B603/B605/B607 runs in CI pipeline. No noqa suppressions bypass these rules. os module usage limited to os.getenv() only (server.py, lifecycle.py).
findings.comments: Human-attested command-injection prevention control for strands-base-agent: command-execution sinks (os.system, os.popen, subprocess with shell=True or string command, eval, exec) are prohibited by enforced lint rules. Enforcement is active in pyproject.toml via ruff S102/S307/S602/S603/S604/S605/S606/S607 and in local/CI lint via bandit B602/B603/B605/B607 (just lint and .github/workflows/ci-cd.yml). Scope scanned (2026-06-22): strands_base_agent/**, tests/** — zero sink hits; no shell-out surface currently exists. If a future exception is required it must use argv-list subprocess invocation (shell=False), avoid partial executable paths, and include inline justification with security review evidence. Adopters whose ATO requires a written prose policy should add it to this comments field in their fork; the baseline relies on the enforced rules above as the policy.

findings.finding_details: [validation] Satisfied via defense-in-depth size/format constraints introduced under FOUNDRY-586 (foundry-agent-core 0.2.4, foundry-agent-fastapi 0.2.2, foundry-strands-agent 0.3.2; bumped to release in PR #396). foundry_agent_core/types.py:12 explicitly cites STIG V-222612 / CCI-002824. (1) HTTP request models bound query (8 KiB), session_id (128 chars, regex ^[A-Za-z0-9_-]+$), context dict (32 keys / 16 KiB) — foundry_agent_fastapi/models/requests.py:44-71. (2) Domain types apply matching Pydantic v2 StringConstraints with _validate_bounded_dict — foundry_agent_core/types.py:16-43; mirrored for RAG types in foundry_strands_agent/types.py:36-45. (3) Orchestrator re-validates max_query_length at runtime — foundry_strands_agent/orchestrator.py:257-266. Starter repo enforces session-id bounds on chat history routes — strands_base_agent/api/routes/chat_history.py:25. Configurable via max_query_length / STRANDS__MAX_QUERY_LENGTH.
